The Speakeasies Swing Band - Theme from The Godfather

The Speakeasies Swing Band! are an awesome retro-swing band from Greece. Heavily-inspired by 30s-40s swing, they produce a unique sound using modern sound equipment and "gypsy" instruments (heavy piano, violin, and clarinet). After releasing an EP in 2013, they finally just released a full album (on Spotify and Apple Music). I hope you guys will love them as much as I do.

Edit: as well as writing they're own stuff, they've also been covering some famous works as well. I particularly enjoy their cover of "Why Don't You do Right?".
